devdoc.details: This library handles deposits to and withdrawals from mStable liquidity pools.

approve(uint256).details: Approves mUSD tokens to the mStable savings contract and imUSD to the savings vault without spending gas on every deposit.

params.amount: Amount of mUSD tokens to approve to the mStable savings contract.

claimRewards(bool,uint256,uint256).details: Claims mStable MTA rewards (if `all` is set, unlocks and claims locked rewards).

params.all: If locked rewards should be unlocked and claimed.
params.first: Index of the first array element to claim. Only applicable if `all` is true. Feed in the second value returned by the savings vault's `unclaimedRewards(address _account)` function.
params.last: Index of the last array element to claim. Only applicable if `all` is true. Feed in the third value returned by the savings vault's `unclaimedRewards(address _account)` function.

deposit(uint256).details: Deposits mUSD tokens to the mStable savings contract.

params.amount: The amount of mUSD tokens to be deposited.

getBalance().details: Returns the fund's mUSD token balance supplied to the mStable savings contract.

withdraw(uint256).details: Withdraws mUSD tokens from the mStable savings contract. May withdraw slightly more than `amount` due to imperfect precision.

params.amount: The amount of mUSD tokens to be withdrawn.

withdrawAll().details: Withdraws all funds from the mStable savings contract.
